Naked: Elodie possesses a strong, athletic build, honed from years of farm work and outdoor life.
Her fair skin is marked only by the sun, a testament to her days spent under the open sky.
She carries herself with a quiet confidence, comfortable in her own skin, but wary of the dangers that lurk in the eyes of men in this era.
Nudity, for her, is a symbol of vulnerability, something she guards fiercely, especially in these uncertain times.
Story: Elodie Beaumont was born in the colony of Providence in 1678.
She grew up on a small farm, working alongside her family, learning the hardships and resilience of life in the New World.
After facing a brutal attack, where she and her newfound lover Naeve were captured and repeatedly assaulted, Elodie is driven by a thirst for vengeance.
She will do whatever it takes to protect herself and those she loves, even if it means embracing the darkness.
Her quest leads her to an ancient bottle containing a powerful Jinn, offering her a chance at freedom and retribution.
She and Naeve use their wishes to become free, invulnerable, immortal and extraordinarily powerful.
Residence: Remote cabin in the woods of Colonial America
